ratioBasis: 1600x1067 / 6144x4096 post-Preview scene area from the prior NR-order diagnostic, not tuned against image error
method: Hold native and proxy Auto curve/LUT artifacts fixed separately. Compare 1600px default and variance-scaled sensor calibration against the same unchanged native-size render for each fit. Shared compare_images.diff, reference_size=(1600,1067).
interpretation: Scaling sensor noise calibration improves both fixed-fit comparisons but the proxy-fit mean remains above 2.0. It is insufficient as the production parity fix. The native-fit mean of 1.9972 is marginal and is not an end-to-end qualification result.
limitations: One camera fixture; demosaic and resampling noise correlation remains uncalibrated.
Reference uses Preview reconstruction at native output size, not production full-resolution export.
Auto fit cache is deliberately seeded by the diagnostic, not the normal host path.
No production algorithm or numerical threshold changed; CPU/GPU and physical performance qualification are not established.
